case: C-779/21 P and C-799/21 P (Commission v Front Polisario; Council v Front Polisario)
subject: EU-Morocco agricultural liberalisation agreement
holding: Appeals dismissed in their entirety; the 2019 agreements were concluded in breach of the principles of self-determination and the relative effect of treaties

subject: Country-of-origin labelling of melons and tomatoes
holding: Produce harvested in Western Sahara must be labelled Western Sahara, not Morocco; Western Sahara is a separate and distinct customs territory; Member States may not adopt unilateral national import bans
